user.title: Entity Selection
user.description:
Select the entities for your pergola bioclimatique setup.

Sun integration status: **{sun_status}**

data_description.pv_power_entity: Optional. At least one of PV power or light sensor is recommended for cloud detection.
data_description.light_sensor_entity: Optional. Used as alternative to PV power for cloud detection.
data_description.humidity_entity: Optional. Blocks automation when humidity exceeds threshold.
data_description.priority_lock_entity: Optional. Monitors safety locks (rain, temperature, security).
data_description.priority_lock_timer_entity: Optional. Timer for safety lock duration.

geometry.title: Geometry Parameters
geometry.description: Configure the physical geometry of your pergola.

data_description.max_opening_angle: Maximum tilt angle of the blades in degrees.
data_description.calibration_offset: Permanent correction offset for blade angle.
data_description.blade_pitch_ratio: Ratio P/W between blade pitch (center-to-center) and blade width. Default 0.92 for waterproof louvers; tune so the post-bascule target matches what you observe blocks best.
data_description.flip_profile_threshold: Profile angle (°) at which the blades flip from side A (clamped at 100% / full tilt) to side B (cutoff geometry, low tilt). Calibrate by observing sensor.pergola_profile_angle the moment a first beam of sun starts to leak past the fully-tilted blades. Default 80°; lower if the bascule happens too late, raise if too early.
data_description.summer_blade_offset: Extra blade angle offset (°) applied to the summer algorithm phase B only (post-bascule, additive on top of calibration_offset). Does not affect phase A nor winter. Positive value = more closure on side B after the bascule.
data_description.phase_a_intercept: Target percent at profile_angle=0 for the linear phase A ramp. Phase A interpolates linearly from this value up to 100% at the flip_profile_threshold. Calibrate by reading sensor.pergola_profile_angle at a moment when you observe the minimum closure that blocks rays — e.g. if at profile=60° the minimum is 85%, with threshold=85° this implies intercept ≈ (85·85 − 100·60) / (85−60) = 40%.
data_description.sun_az_min: Sun azimuth (°) at which the sun starts hitting the pergola in the morning. Below this azimuth the building itself shadows the protected zone and the algorithm falls back to the cloudy/diffuse position. Default face_azimuth − 90°; raise it if you observe the pergola is still shaded for a while after the sun rises above the eastern wall.
data_description.sun_az_max: Sun azimuth (°) past which the sun no longer hits the pergola in the late afternoon. Above this azimuth the algorithm falls back to the cloudy/diffuse position. Default face_azimuth + 90°; lower it if the western wall starts shadowing the protected zone before then.

data_description.update_interval: How often the control loop runs.
data_description.step_size: Position is rounded to multiples of this value to reduce mechanical wear.
data_description.deadband: Minimum position change required to trigger movement.
data_description.cloudy_target: Default position when cloudy or in standby.
data_description.min_useful_percent: Below this position, switch to standby instead.
data_description.humidity_max: Automation is blocked when humidity exceeds this value.
data_description.min_elevation: Below this sun elevation, the control loop and morning calibration are inactive.

cloud_detection.title: Cloud Detection Parameters
cloud_detection.description: Configure sun/cloud detection using your power or light sensor.

data_description.pv_max_watts: Peak power output of your PV sensor under ideal conditions.
data_description.pv_panel_azimuth: Compass direction the PV panels face (0°=N, 90°=E, 180°=S, 270°=W). Defaults to the pergola face — override only if panels are on a different roof slope.
data_description.pv_panel_tilt: Tilt angle of the PV panels in degrees (0° = horizontal, 90° = vertical).
data_description.pv_sunny_ratio: Fraction of modelled clear-sky power above which the sky is considered sunny.
data_description.pv_smooth_alpha: Weight of new readings vs. history (higher = more reactive).
data_description.hysteresis_duration: Minimum time before switching between sunny/cloudy state.
data_description.lux_sunny_ratio: Lux above this × sin(sun elevation) is considered sunny. Tune from a clear midday reading.
data_description.pv_observable_cos: PV is only used to vote 'sunny' when cos(angle of incidence on the panel) exceeds this value — protects against false-cloudy when the panel is too off-axis or shaded.
data_description.lux_az_min: Sun azimuth (°) at which the lux sensor starts seeing direct sun.
data_description.lux_az_max: Sun azimuth (°) past which the lux sensor no longer sees direct sun.
